title: Workflow guard overlap and final-state reachability
invariant: Reject overlapping guards for one event and reachable states with no path to a final state.
scope: Finite supplied compiler configs: scalar guard constraints and structural reachability. Recognizes only recorded JavaScript AST shapes; does not prove arbitrary JavaScript or runtime trace feasibility.
